description.value: A large Township of Langley municipal recreation centre in Walnut Grove featuring a 50-metre pool with waterslide, diving boards, a 5-metre dive tower, leisure pool, sauna, steam room, and whirlpools. The facility also houses a fitness centre, gymnasium, library branch, and a fresh food café. Accessibility features include a portable aquatic lift, water wheelchairs, and ramp access into the therapy and leisure pools.

address.value: 8889 Walnut Grove Drive, Langley, BC V1M 2N7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Township of Langley municipal community centre with a pool complex, fitness centre, gymnasium, library, and leased café space. OSM tags confirm public flush toilets, and the website corroborates washrooms under the accessibility section. The website lists 'Second Wave - fresh food café' as a leased space on-site. Change rooms with showers are part of the pool facility, accessible via drop-in. No mention of bike parking, water refill stations, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public municipal recreation centre offering touring cyclists access to showers via pool drop-in, public washrooms, and an on-site café — practical amenities for riders passing through the Walnut Grove area of Langley.

Showers (drop-in or fee).detail: Change rooms with handheld shower heads available as part of pool facility; drop-in schedules referenced on website

Café or food on site.detail: Second Wave - fresh food café listed as leased space on-site (604-888-7995)

wow_evidence: 50 m pool, dive tower, sauna, steam room — pool ladder 1/2.
blurb: Rec centre with 50 m pool, sauna, and steam room in Walnut Grove.
